name: v6-d-idioms-full
note: V6 iteration 2. Evidence from iteration 1 (C1301, 24 steps): the curriculum transfers in likelihood (code-only loss vs round 54: new members of trained families -46%, unseen-v1 -37%, unseen-v2 -23%; experiments/v6/probe_learning.py) but one pass leaves it under-learned (training loss still ~0.42 and falling at step 24; legacy rows sit at ~0.07), and pass rates did not move. Changed variable: learning on the curriculum - the production 72-step budget with each curriculum program seen ~2x as often (4 write + 2 bug-fix examples). Legacy share kept at ~half (basics 2/2, compose 1, novel 1, 200 replay rows) against the forgetting C showed on near-certain items. Everything else as C.
decision: Same pre-registered rule as v6-c-idioms: replaces round 54 only if every seed beats its all_clean (29/168), the mean gain is >= 3 items, and no category loses >= 3 clean items round 54 passes. The benchmark is reported only.
